title: Hyp Group Consumers
objective: Profile and accelerate group structure, explicit maps, and genus-3 certification consumers independently of the core kernel, preserving certificates.

handoff.summary: Final exact 523c910e pinned-Node-22 certification completes p<=100000 with the established exact digest under the documented NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=256 resource envelope. It takes 142.180 seconds, peaks at 338968 KiB OS RSS, and passes the exactness, 5x speedup, 300-second wall, and 512 MiB memory gates. The receipt preserves the exact default-heap 523c910e result and the earlier 158acf09 near-miss as immutable diagnostics.
risks: The passing Phase-4 memory result depends on the supported 256 MiB V8 old-space process envelope; default V8 sizing remains above the 512 MiB OS-RSS gate on the pinned host.
The lane base predates substantial integration work; integrate this receipt/documentation commit rather than merging the branch wholesale.
next_steps: Preserve NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=256 and record the V8-reported 318767104-byte heap limit in comparable Phase-4 acceptance runs.
Retain the immutable default-heap and 158acf09 receipts as diagnostics for future allocator or native-buffer improvements.
